correctness.rationale: Under strict Euclidean positive-definite contraction hypotheses, parallel C relaxation gives Fx at every positive coarse index from constant initialization; the second F relaxation does not change C points. The fine coarse-point residuals are zero at index one and (F²−F)x thereafter. Exact coarse forward substitution gives the ordered partial geometric sum and operator-norm convergence to V∞=F−C⁻¹D for C=I−Ψ and D=F(I−F). D^{1/2} conjugates this to H=F−D^{1/2}C⁻¹D^{1/2}≺I. Complementing the symmetric block matrix with diagonal blocks I+F and C first on C and then on I+F gives Inertia(I+H)=Inertia((I+F²)(I+F)⁻¹−Ψ), including nullity. Thus singular semidefinite difference gives a nondecaying −1 mode; a negative direction gives an eigenvalue below −1. Direct 2×2 arithmetic gives trace 43/840 and determinant (2−15 sin²θ)/3360 of the difference; at π/4 the endpoint trace is −51/32 and determinant 27/64, giving the stated eigenvalues. This is an analytic verification of the limiting restart, not of a finite-length trajectory or repeated solves on one trajectory. The frozen check.py was inspected, not executed.
